_comment: Biology review batch 11: 26 questions across TWO exports whose display numbering
restarts independently. File A supplied 5 questions (A1-A5), File B supplied 21
(B1-B21). The exports carried no bank ids, so each item was matched to the bank by
its full stem AND option texts, never by topic or by position.
The map below was verified four independent ways before any edit was applied:
1. a distinctive stem+option signature per item matched exactly one bank record;
2. every stored key letter equals the key the review asserts;
3. both of the review's key tallies reproduce (File A A=2 B=1 C=2 D=0;
File B A=4 B=5 C=7 D=5);
4. the four existing tables sit exactly at A3, B2, B13 and B17, and every point
count matches the review's inventory (A 3,5,5,0,6; every File B item 3).
The ids are NOT contiguous: bio-611, bio-616, bio-620, bio-625 and bio-628 fall
inside the range but belong to batch 2, and bio-253, bio-277, bio-282, bio-462 and
bio-608 sit far outside it. A5's 8 cM topic is shared with batch 10's bio-577, so
A5 was pinned by its option set (42% and 16%), not by topic.
Reconciled against the 31 remaining ids reported after batch 10. All 26 of this
batch's verified ids fall inside that set, so no previously reviewed item was
included again, and exactly five genuinely unreviewed biology items remain.
